name: Incident Response workspace declaration, lifecycle state machine, cross-domain references, and timeline

planSteps.description: Navigate to /incidents on the PolarOps frontend
Verify Incident Response workspace header 'Incident Response - Polar station alarms, field anomalies, hazard containment, and operational triage' is visible
Verify search input, severity filter pills (ALL, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL), status selector, and 'Declare Incident' button are present
Verify operational incident table renders incident codes, titles, severity badges, priority numbers, and statuses
Click 'Declare Incident' button to open the CreateIncidentWorkflow modal
Verify declaration modal contains fields for code, title, description, severity, priority, type, location, and reporter
Fill required fields and submit declaration modal
Verify newly declared incident appears in the incident table
Click on an incident code chip or row to open the IncidentDetailPanel drawer
Verify drawer displays incident overview with high-visibility severity badge, priority, location, and detected timestamp
Verify valid lifecycle action buttons reflect state machine (e.g. Acknowledge, Start Mitigation, Resolve, Close)
Verify terminal CLOSED state disables state transitions and displays terminal closure notice
In Cross-Domain References section, select reference type (ASSET, LOCATION, INVENTORY_STOCK_LOT, CARGO_CONSIGNMENT, TRANSPORT_LEG), enter reference ID and notes, and click Attach Reference
Verify attached reference appears in references list with timestamp and provenance tag
Verify operational timeline displays chronological lifecycle transitions and event context
